how_to_read: Sources marked checked_by_human=false were found by Claude through web search and only the search snippet was read. Open each link and confirm before citing.

ceeol.title: Borana pastoralists: cattle losses in the 2016-2017 drought (household survey, 529 households)
ceeol.says: About 55% of cattle lost in the 2016-2017 drought.

fao_loss.title: FAO/ILCA: Borana herd losses in the 1980s drought
fao_loss.says: Net herd loss about 60% (42% deaths, 14% sales, 4% slaughter).

fao_price.title: FAO/ILCA: livestock terms of trade in the 1980s Borana drought
fao_price.says: Live cattle price fell about 70% (1.00 to 0.30 Birr per kg) during the drought.

springer_cs.title: Condition score and live weight in Boran cattle
springer_cs.says: One point on the 9-point condition scale is about 24 kg in Boran cows.

mdpi_spi.title: Effects of drought on livestock production, market dynamics and pastoralists' adaptation (Borana; MDPI Climate 2025)
mdpi_spi.says: Links the drought index (SPI) to livestock market prices. Best published match for calibrating the crash effect; read it for the actual numbers.

yeda.title: Tikvah Ethiopia news, 22 Nehase 2018 E.C.: Yeda district (North Gondar, Amhara) drought
yeda.says: District office says about 15,000 animals died in roughly 50 days from 1 Hamle 2018. Herd size and species are not given, so no rate can be computed; different region and farming system.

A time-based backtest on the NMIS data showed no gain over a 'no change' forecast, so the trend is set to 0 (reports/PRICE_BACKTEST.md).
A policy choice (expected loss from waiting under 1% means hold). Agree it with herders and experts; it is not a measured value.

The Borana SPI notebook was run on 2026-11-07 using ERA5 rainfall for six Borana points plus ONI and DMI. Its logistic model did not beat historical climatology on the 2013-2018 validation period (Brier skill -0.047), so the current dated outlook uses historical-average probabilities only, not a skillful drought prediction. The advisor uses it for five listed Borana markets and correctly reports LOW drought confidence. Other markets have no town-level forecast. Rainfall alone does not measure forage, soil moisture, or animal outcomes.
